column1: # The DEFAULT is that every case runs on every axis (jit, aot-o0, aot-o2,
# vm-src, vm-eskb) and must match its hand-authored golden. This file is the
# only way to exempt a (case, axis) pair, and every row needs a justification,
# so an engine losing a `guard` form has to be written down rather than
# quietly dropped. scripts/run_guard_coverage.sh fails on a row naming a case
# or axis that does not exist (a stale waiver) and on a row with no
#   axis  — jit | aot-o0 | aot-o2 | vm-src | vm-eskb
